tiles: Constructivist forms shaping interiors and landscapes
Flowing curves meet geometric rhythm and bold color
Generative compositions refined with disciplined finishing
challenge: Applying constructivist form language to both interior spaces and open landscapes, creating compositions that feel human-centered despite their abstraction. The challenge was maintaining geometric clarity and directional flow while evoking warmth and lived-in atmosphere across a variety of settings.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to establish core compositional forms and spatial axes across interior and landscape scenes. Lightroom refined color relationships and value steps, while targeted in-painting sharpened edge discipline and spatial pacing to unify the series.
result: Produced a cohesive six-piece collection that bridges architectural interiors and natural landscapes through consistent constructivist structure. The panels read clearly at tile scale and sustain layered detail for art prints and portfolio presentation.
